title: A Local Approximation Characterization of Oka Manifolds
summary: We introduce the local approximation propert (LAP) and prove that it characterizes Oka manifolds. We prove that LAP yields convex approximation and, in an $n$-dimensional target, propagates across sets of zero $(2n-1)$-dimensional Hausdorff measure. Consequently, strong dominability characterizes Oka manifolds, convex approximation in the target dimension suffices, the Oka property is local in the Euclidean topology, and it descends under surjective holomorphic maps.
